text:
The river forks, and both paths lead to the mountain's peak. One is shrouded in mist, the other bathed in blinding sun. Which will you choose, seeker? 

Know this: The mist hides not only perils, but also hidden springs. The sun may scorch, but also illuminate the path. Trust neither sight nor fear, but the compass within. 

Listen to the whispers of the wind, for it carries the stories of those who have walked both paths.  The choice is not in the destination, but in the journey itself.
